content:
The **Scenic Overlook** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

Perched on top of the cliff, this overlook provides a stunning view of The Forest and the Ash Heap in the distance. Unfortunately, it contains little in the way of loot.

There is a mysterious button in the leftmost port-a-potty, connected to the emergency exit from the nearby missile Site Charlie.

Close-by to the northeast, there are three cabins, one of them inhabited by Settlers. Not much further away to the same direction, there is a ruined house decorated with Halloween ornaments.

The Scenic Overlook appears in *Fallout 76*.
